items.source: Invoked on initialization of this FactoryBean in case of a shared singleton; else, on each getObject() call.
items.translation: 在共享单例的情况下，在本工厂 Bean 初始化时调用；否则，在每次getObject()调用时调用。

items.source:
Supports loading from a properties file and/or setting local properties
on this FactoryBean. The created Properties instance will be merged from
loaded and local values. If neither a location nor local properties are set,
an exception will be thrown on initialization.
items.translation: 支持从属性文件加载和/或在此 FactoryBean 上设置本地属性。创建的 Properties 实例将从加载的值和本地值中合并。如果未设置位置或本地属性，则在初始化时将抛出异常。

items.source:
Can create a singleton or a new object on each request.
Default is a singleton.
items.translation: 可以创建单例或在每个请求上创建新对象。默认是单例。

items.source: Default is "true" (a shared singleton).
items.translation: 默认值为 "true"（一个共享的单例）。

items.source: isSingleton in interface FactoryBean<Properties>
items.translation: `isSingleton` 在接口 `FactoryBean<Properties>` 中

items.source: getObject in interface FactoryBean<Properties>
items.translation: `getObject` 在接口 `FactoryBean<Properties>` 中

items.source: getObjectType in interface FactoryBean<Properties>
items.translation: `getObjectType` 在接口 `FactoryBean<Properties>` 中

items.source: IOException - if an exception occurred during properties loading
items.translation: IOException - 如果在加载属性期间发生异常

items.source: NOTE: This method returning false does not necessarily indicate that returned objects are independent instances. An implementation of the extended SmartFactoryBean interface may explicitly indicate independent instances through its SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() method. Plain FactoryBean implementations which do not implement this extended interface are simply assumed to always return independent instances if the isSingleton() implementation returns false.
items.translation: 注意：此方法返回 false 并不一定表示返回的对象是独立实例。实现扩展的SmartFactoryBean接口的实现可以通过其 SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() 方法明确指示独立实例。未实现此扩展接口的普通 FactoryBean 实现，如果其isSingleton() 实现返回 false，则假定总是返回独立实例。

items.source: NOTE: If a FactoryBean indicates that it holds a singleton object, the object returned from getObject() might get cached by the owning BeanFactory. Hence, do not return true unless the FactoryBean always exposes the same reference.
items.translation: 注意：如果 FactoryBean 表明它持有一个单例对象，那么从 getObject() 返回的对象可能会被其拥有的 BeanFactory 缓存。因此，除非 FactoryBean 始终暴露相同的引用，否则不要返回 true。

items.source: FactoryBeans are allowed to return null objects. The bean factory will consider this as a normal value to be used and will not throw a FactoryBeanNotInitializedException in this case. However, FactoryBean implementations are encouraged to throw FactoryBeanNotInitializedException themselves, as appropriate.
items.translation: FactoryBeans 允许返回 `null` 对象。在此情况下，Bean 工厂会将其视为正常值并使用该值，而不会抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。不过，建议 FactoryBean 实现类根据具体情况自行抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。

items.source: The default implementation returns true, since a FactoryBean typically manages a singleton instance.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 true，因为 FactoryBean 通常管理一个单例实例。

items.source: As with a BeanFactory, this allows support for both the Singleton and Prototype design patterns.
items.translation: 与BeanFactory一样，它支持单例和原型这两种设计模式。

items.source: If this FactoryBean is not fully initialized yet at the time of the call (for example because it is involved in a circular reference), throw a corresponding FactoryBeanNotInitializedException.
items.translation: 如果在此调用时该 FactoryBean 尚未完全初始化（例如因为它涉及循环引用），则抛出相应的FactoryBeanNotInitializedException。

items.source: NOTE: Autowiring will simply ignore FactoryBeans that return null here. Therefore, it is highly recommended to implement this method properly, using the current state of the FactoryBean.
items.translation: 注意： 自动装配将简单地忽略在此处返回`null`的 FactoryBean。因此，强烈建议使用 FactoryBean 的当前状态正确实现此方法。

items.source: This method can be called before this FactoryBean has been fully initialized. It must not rely on state created during initialization; of course, it can still use such state if available.
items.translation: 此方法可以在该 FactoryBean 完全初始化之前被调用。它不能依赖在初始化期间创建的状态；当然，如果可用，它仍然可以使用此类状态。

items.source:
The singleton status of the FactoryBean itself will generally
be provided by the owning BeanFactory; usually, it has to be
defined as singleton there.
items.translation: FactoryBean 本身的单例状态通常由拥有它的 BeanFactory 提供；通常，它必须在那里被定义为单例。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source:
This allows one to check for specific types of beans without
instantiating objects, for example on autowiring.
items.translation: 这允许在例如自动装配时，无需实例化对象即可检查特定类型的 Bean。

items.source:
In the case of implementations that create a singleton object,
this method should try to avoid singleton creation as far as possible;
it should rather estimate the type in advance.
For prototypes, returning a meaningful type here is advisable too.
items.translation: 对于创建单例对象的实现，此方法应尽可能避免创建单例；相反，它应预先估算类型。对于原型对象，在此处返回有意义的类型也是可取的。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.source: Is the object managed by this factory a singleton? That is, will FactoryBean.getObject() always return the same object (a reference that can be cached)?
items.translation: 该工厂管理的对象是单例吗？也就是说，FactoryBean.getObject() 是否总是返回同一个对象（一个可以缓存的引用）？

items.source: Return the type of object that this FactoryBean creates, or null if not known in advance.
items.translation: 返回此 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，如果无法预先确定则返回 `null`。

items.source:
Template method that subclasses may override to construct the object
returned by this factory.
items.translation: 子类可重写以构造此工厂返回对象的模板方法。

items.source:
Return an instance (possibly shared or independent) of the object
managed by this factory.
items.translation: 返回由该工厂管理的对象的实例（可能是共享的或独立的）。

items.source:
Set whether a shared 'singleton' Properties instance should be
created, or rather a new Properties instance on each request.
items.translation: 设置是创建一个共享的'singleton'Properties 实例，还是在每个请求上创建一个新的 Properties 实例。

items.translation: 该 FactoryBean 创建的对象类型，或在调用时未知则为 `null`。
